title.en: Income Tax (Singapore — India) (Avoidance of Double Taxation Agreement) (Modifications to Implement Multilateral Instrument) Order 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Income Tax (Singapore — India) (Avoidance of Double Taxation Agreement) (Modifications to Implement Multilateral Instrument) Order 2019 and comes into operation on 1 October 2019.

2.—(1) This Order amends the arrangements made between the Government of the Republic of Singapore and the Government of the Republic of India as specified in the Schedule to the Income Tax (Singapore — India) (Avoidance of Double Taxation Agreement) Order 1994 (O 14(A)) (called in this Order the Agreement), as modified —
(a)by the Protocol specified in the Schedule to the Income Tax (Singapore — India) (Avoidance of Double Taxation Agreement) Order 2005 (G.N. No. S 515/2005);
(b)by the Second Protocol specified in the Schedule to the Income Tax (Singapore — India) (Avoidance of Double Taxation Agreement) Order 2011 (G.N. No. S 463/2011); and
(c)by the Third Protocol specified in the Schedule to the Income Tax (Singapore — India) (Avoidance of Double Taxation Agreement) Order 2017 (G.N. No. S 71/2017).
(2) The purpose of this Order is to amend the Agreement to give effect to Singapore’s obligations under the Multilateral Convention to Implement Tax Treaty Related Measures to Prevent Base Erosion and Profit Shifting done at Paris on 24 November 2016 (as amended from time to time).
3. The provisions of the Agreement are amended in the manner set out in the Schedule.

4. The amendments mentioned in paragraph 3 have effect —
(a)with respect to taxes withheld at source, in respect of amounts paid, deemed paid or liable to be paid (whichever is the earliest), on or after 1 January 2020; and
(b)with respect to taxes other than those withheld at source, where the income is derived or received in a basis period beginning on or after 1 April 2020.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 3
Deletion and replacement of Preamble
1. The Preamble of the Agreement is deleted and replaced by the following Preamble:
“The Government of the Republic of Singapore and the Government of the Republic of India,
Desiring to conclude an Agreement for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income,
Intending to eliminate double taxation with respect to the taxes covered by this Agreement without creating opportunities for non‑taxation or reduced taxation through tax evasion or avoidance (including through treaty‑shopping arrangements aimed at obtaining reliefs provided in this Agreement for the indirect benefit of residents of third jurisdictions),
Have agreed as follows:”.
New Article 29A
2. The Agreement is amended by inserting, immediately after Article 29 (Diplomatic and Consular Officials), the following Article:
“Article 29A
PREVENTION OF TREATY ABUSE
Notwithstanding any provisions of this Agreement, a benefit under this Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Agreement.”.
